search_space: All x in the fixed tuple (1, 2, 3); for each x, the program checks the two-step composition when both required arrows occur in the quoted partial maps right={3: 2} and other={2: 1}, against cycle (3, 2, 1).
witness_description: x=3: applying the stated rightmost arrow and then the other arrow sends 3 to 1, while (321) sends 3 to 2.
refutation_explanation: For x=3, the quote states 3->2 under the rightmost cycle and 2->1 under the other cycle, so rightmost-first composition gives 3->1. But the cycle (321) gives 3->2. Thus (321) cannot represent the described composition.
